senses.gloss: (denom. of קְטַם III) to cover with ashes or powder.
units: Shebi. II, 4 קוֹטְמִין אותן you may cover them with powder (v. אָבַק); [oth. opin., v. קָטַם I.]—Esp. to cover embers with ashes on which to put dishes to be kept warm for the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1:8">Y. Sabb. III, beg. 5ᶜ</cite> <he>הקוֹטֵם עד שיִקְטוֹם וכ׳</he> he that covers must not put dishes on until he has sufficiently covered (choked the flame).
<cite ref="Shabbat 37a:8">Sabb. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>קְטָמָהּ</he>, v. <cite ref="L00049"><he>לָבָה</he></cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>קָטוּם</he>; f. <cite ref="S00727"><he>קְטוּמָה</he></cite> &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3">Tosef. ib. III</cite>, (II) 3 <he>אחת גרופה וק׳</he> one part of the double store being swept or covered.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>הרי הן כק׳</he> they are considered as if they were covered; a. e.
